```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# SETTING UP LIBRARIES
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(Metrics)
library(forecast)
library(glmnet)
```

## Loading Datasets
```{r}

data = read.csv("../data/data_merged.csv")
data_mean = read.csv("../data/prevail_mean.csv")

data$date <- as.Date(data$date)
data_mean$date <- as.Date(data_mean$date)

data <- data %>%
  select(
    date,
    log_ret,
    matches("_L[1-4]$")       # only lagged features
  ) %>%
  select(-matches("price")) %>% 
  left_join(
    data_mean %>% select(date, mean_prevailing_ret),
    by = "date"
  )

```

## LASSO Regression Model

# ============================================================================
# MODELING APPROACH: 80/20 Train-Test Split w/ Recursive CV
# ============================================================================

```{r}
# --- STEP 1: Prepare data ---

lasso_df <- data %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  select(-mean_prevailing_ret) %>%
  drop_na()

set.seed(123)

n <- nrow(lasso_df)
train_size <- floor(0.8 * n)  # 80% training
test_size <- n - train_size   # 20% testing

cat("\n=== Data Split ===\n")
cat("Training:", train_size, "observations\n")
cat("Testing :", test_size, "observations\n")

train_data <- lasso_df[1:train_size, ]
test_data  <- lasso_df[(train_size + 1):n, ]

# Extract features and target
X_train <- train_data %>% select(-date, -log_ret) %>% as.matrix()
y_train <- train_data$log_ret

X_test <- test_data %>% select(-date, -log_ret) %>% as.matrix()
y_test <- test_data$log_ret

cat("\nFeatures in model:", ncol(X_train), "\n")

```

## Helper Functions: BIC-based Lambda Selection

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# BIC-based Lambda Selection Functions (Kock & Callot)
# BIC(λ) = log(RSS(λ)) + (log(T)/T)·df(λ)
# ============================================================================

# Function 1: Compute degrees of freedom for LASSO
# df(λ) = number of non-zero coefficients
compute_lasso_df <- function(coef_matrix) {
  # Count non-zero coefficients (excluding intercept)
  df <- sum(coef_matrix != 0)
  return(df)
}

# Function 2: Fit LASSO Regression and compute BIC for each lambda
fit_lasso_bic <- function(X, y, alpha = 1, lambdas = NULL) {
  
  # ---- Input validation ----
  T <- nrow(X)
  
  if (length(y) != T) stop("X and y must have same number of rows")
  if (!is.matrix(X)) X <- as.matrix(X)
  
  # Fit glmnet (lasso: alpha=1, standardize=TRUE, intercept=TRUE)
  fit <- glmnet(X, y, alpha = alpha, standardize = TRUE, intercept = TRUE, 
                lambda = lambdas, thresh = 1e-7)
  
  # ---- Compute RSS on training data ----
  # Get predictions for each lambda
  y_pred_matrix <- predict(fit, newx = X, s = fit$lambda)
  
  # RSS for each lambda
  RSS_vec <- colSums((y - y_pred_matrix)^2)
  
  # ---- Compute degrees of freedom for each lambda ----
  # For LASSO: df = number of non-zero coefficients
  coef_matrix <- coef(fit)[-1, ]  # exclude intercept
  df_vec <- colSums(coef_matrix != 0)
  
  # ---- Compute BIC: log(RSS) + (log(T)/T) * df ----
  bic_penalty <- log(T) / T
  BIC_vec <- log(RSS_vec) + bic_penalty * df_vec
  
  # ---- Find optimal lambda ----
  idx_best <- which.min(BIC_vec)
  lambda_best <- fit$lambda[idx_best]
  
  # ---- Create results table ----
  bic_tbl <- data.frame(
    lambda = fit$lambda,
    RSS = RSS_vec,
    df = df_vec,
    BIC = BIC_vec,
    is_best = (fit$lambda == lambda_best)
  )
  
  # ---- Return results ----
  return(list(
    lambda_best = lambda_best,
    bic_tbl = bic_tbl,
    fit = fit
  ))
}

# Function 3: Helper to select lambda by BIC
# Dispatches based on alpha (0=Ridge, 1=Lasso)
select_lambda_bic <- function(X, y, alpha = 1, lambdas = NULL) {
  
  if (is.null(lambdas)) {
    # Generate default lambda sequence (glmnet default behavior)
    lambdas <- 10^seq(5, -2, length.out = 100)
  }
  
  if (alpha == 1) {
    # LASSO Regression
    result <- fit_lasso_bic(X, y, alpha = 1, lambdas = lambdas)
  } else if (alpha == 0) {
    # Ridge (not implemented here, but structure ready)
    stop("Ridge not implemented in this file. Use alpha=1 for LASSO.")
  } else {
    stop("alpha must be 0 (Ridge) or 1 (LASSO)")
  }
  
  return(result)
}

```

## Example: LASSO Regression with BIC Lambda Selection

```{r}
# ---- Fit LASSO Regression using BIC for lambda selection ----

# Generate lambda sequence (smaller range)
lambdas <- 10^seq(2, -5, length.out = 50)

# Fit lasso with BIC
lasso_result <- select_lambda_bic(X_train, y_train, alpha = 1, lambdas = lambdas)

cat("\n=== LASSO Regression: BIC-based Lambda Selection ===\n")
cat("Optimal λ:", round(lasso_result$lambda_best, 6), "\n")
cat("Training size (T):", nrow(X_train), "\n")

# Display top 10 lambdas by BIC
top_bics <- lasso_result$bic_tbl %>%
  arrange(BIC) %>%
  head(10)

cat("\nTop 10 λ values by BIC:\n")
print(top_bics)

```

```{r}
# ---- Predict on test set ----

# Extract the fitted model
fit <- lasso_result$fit
lambda_opt <- lasso_result$lambda_best

# Predict on test data
y_pred_test <- predict(fit, newx = X_test, s = lambda_opt)

# Compute test metrics
mae_lasso <- mae(y_test, y_pred_test)
rmse_lasso <- rmse(y_test, y_pred_test)
r2_lasso <- cor(y_test, y_pred_test)^2

cat("\n=== LASSO Regression Test Performance ===\n")
cat("MAE :", round(mae_lasso, 6), "\n")
cat("RMSE:", round(rmse_lasso, 6), "\n")
cat("R²  :", round(r2_lasso, 4), "\n")

```

```{r}
# ---- Visualize BIC curve ----

ggplot(lasso_result$bic_tbl, aes(x = log10(lambda), y = BIC)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(data = lasso_result$bic_tbl %>% filter(is_best), 
             color = "red", size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "LASSO Regression: BIC vs Log10(λ)",
    x = "Log10(λ)",
    y = "BIC",
    subtitle = paste("Optimal λ =", round(lasso_result$lambda_best, 6))
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic"))

```

```{r}
# ---- Extract and display coefficients ----

# Get coefficients at optimal lambda
coefs <- coef(fit, s = lambda_opt)

# Convert to data frame for better display
coefs_df <- data.frame(
  feature = rownames(coefs),
  coefficient = as.numeric(coefs)
)

# Extract and display intercept
intercept <- coefs_df %>% filter(feature == "(Intercept)") %>% pull(coefficient)

cat("\n=== LASSO Regression Intercept (λ =", round(lambda_opt, 6), ") ===\n")
cat("Intercept:", round(intercept, 8), "\n")

# Remove intercept row for feature coefficients display
coefs_df <- coefs_df %>% filter(feature != "(Intercept)")

# Sort by absolute value for easier interpretation
coefs_df <- coefs_df %>%
  mutate(abs_coef = abs(coefficient)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_coef))

cat("\n=== LASSO Regression Coefficients (λ =", round(lambda_opt, 6), ") ===\n")
cat("Number of non-zero coefficients:", sum(coefs_df$coefficient != 0), "\n")
print(coefs_df)

```

```{r}
# ---- Visualize coefficients ----

ggplot(coefs_df, aes(x = reorder(feature, coefficient), y = coefficient, fill = coefficient > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("steelblue", "coral"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "LASSO Regression Coefficients",
    x = "Feature",
    y = "Coefficient Value"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
# ---- Visualize forecasted vs actual returns on test set ----

# Create a data frame for plotting
test_results <- data.frame(
  date = test_data$date,
  actual = y_test,
  forecasted = as.numeric(y_pred_test),
  obs_num = seq_along(y_test)
)

# Line plot: Forecasted vs Actual
ggplot(test_results, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = actual, color = "Actual"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = forecasted, color = "LASSO Forecast"), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "LASSO Regression: Forecasted vs Actual Returns (Test Set)",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Log Return",
    color = "Series"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Actual" = "steelblue", "LASSO Forecast" = "coral")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

```

```{r}
# ---- Scatter plot: Forecasted vs Actual ----

ggplot(test_results, aes(x = actual, y = forecasted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "steelblue", size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "LASSO Regression: Forecast Accuracy (Test Set)",
    x = "Actual Return",
    y = "Forecasted Return",
    subtitle = paste("R² =", round(r2_lasso, 4), "| RMSE =", round(rmse_lasso, 6))
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1)

```

```{r}
# ---- Save LASSO Regression Predictions and Results ----

# Create results dataframe with predictions
lasso_predictions <- test_results %>%
  select(date, actual, forecasted) %>%
  rename(
    lasso_forecast = forecasted,
    lasso_actual = actual
  )

# Save predictions to CSV
write.csv(lasso_predictions, "../data/lasso_predictions.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save model evaluation metrics
lasso_metrics <- data.frame(
  model = "LASSO Regression",
  optimal_lambda = lasso_result$lambda_best,
  MAE = mae_lasso,
  RMSE = rmse_lasso,
  R2 = r2_lasso
)

write.csv(lasso_metrics, "../data/lasso_metrics.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save BIC table
write.csv(lasso_result$bic_tbl, "../data/lasso_bic_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n=== LASSO Regression Results Saved ===\n")
cat("✓ Predictions saved to: ../data/lasso_predictions.csv\n")
cat("✓ Metrics saved to: ../data/lasso_metrics.csv\n")
cat("✓ BIC table saved to: ../data/lasso_bic_table.csv\n")

```
